# User live mic test 2026-10-06: kinetic and potential energy (formulas were lost: flattened formula JSON).
Let us learn about the kinetic and
potential energy. Kinetic energy is the energy of motion while potential energy is the energy stored based on object's position or state.
[pause 1.2]
Kinetic energy equals half mv square, where m is mass and v is the velocity.
Examples are a rolling ball, a running person or a speeding car.
[pause 1.8]
Potential energy equals mgh that is mass times gravitation times height.
Key factors are mass, height or distance and physical configuration.
e.g. water sitting at top of a dam or a compressed spring.
how it works
the conversion they constantly switch back and forth a drop ball loses height
losing potential energy while speeding up gaining kinetic energy
[pause 1.2]
conservation. Total mechanical energy stays constant in a closed system.
[pause 1.2]
mechanical energy equals potential energy plus kinetic energy
